desc: Shenanigan is the name. Dependable is the game. CRKT reintroduces the classic Shenanigan Series, the everyday workhorse folding knives. Featuring Assisted Opening innovation and IKBS ball bearing pivot system for smooth opening, the knifes prominent flipper deploys its 3.35" black stonewash blade with Veff Serrations breezes through rope and cord. Paired with Kens award-winning Assisted Opening innovation and IKBS ball bearing pivot system for super smooth, fast opening.
